title: Waiting for the right time
lines: You wait for the right time to have children, while the conditions keep moving away.
Who Will Inherit the World asks how the lives we build shape the next generation.
Housing, careers, care networks, and partner choices connect private hopes with the next generation.

title: What institutions pass on
lines: A community may attract thoughtful people while making their preferred family life difficult.
It looks at how habits and beliefs travel through families, while carefully separating those questions from genetics.
It also asks how AI companions, matching systems, and tutors might alter these relationships.

title: Which futures remain possible
lines: The question concerns the worlds we make possible, not a ranking of human worth.
What would make it easier to build the family life people actually want?
